rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Checks that the latest date is identical across all StatVars.
Checks that the latest observation year is within a 2-year lag of the current year (>= CURRENT_YEAR - 2) for all StatVars.

params.condition: TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR)), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= date_part('year', CURRENT_DATE) - 2
